name: Kangokutou Mary Skelter 2
original_name: 神獄塔 メアリスケルター2
source:
'Jail,' an impregnable asylum referred to as "a living prison."

Birthed several decades ago, it was controlled by "Marchens," monsters led by insane beings known as "Nightmares."

Tsuu and Little Mermaid, members of the "Dawn" organization with the goal of escaping the prison, rescue Alice and her partner Jack after being captured.

In the midst of an expedition to the city, Alice was dyed in madness and ran amok slashing through anything and anyone at sight.

In an attempt to protect Tsuu from one of Alice's attacks, Little Mermaid and Jack fell off a cliff with her.

After regaining consciousness, Little Mermaid's first sight was a dying Jack.

The bloodstained story of Tsuu, Little Mermaid and Nightmare Jack trying to escape the tower and their fate begins.
translation:
“监狱”，一个坚不可摧的庇护所，被称为“活监狱”。

它诞生于几十年前，由“Marchens”控制，这些怪物由被称为“Nightmares”的疯狂生物领导。

以逃出监狱为目标的“黎明”组织成员苏和小美人鱼营救了被捕后的爱丽丝和她的搭档杰克。

在一次前往城市的探险中，爱丽丝陷入了疯狂，疯狂地砍伐着眼前的任何东西和任何人。

为了保护阿苏免受爱丽丝的攻击，小美人鱼和杰克与她一起从悬崖上掉下来。

恢复意识后，小美人鱼第一眼看到的是垂死的杰克。

苏、小美人鱼和梦魇杰克试图逃离塔楼的血腥故事开始了。
